hints.title: Prefix Sum Equivalence
hints.text: Removing x stones always results in a new single stone equal to prefix_sum[x - 1].

hints.title: Reverse Dynamic Programming Formulation
hints.text: Let dp[i] be the maximum score difference a player can achieve choosing an index >= i.

hints.title: Backward Suffix Recurrence
hints.text: dp[i] = max(dp[i + 1], prefix_sum[i] - dp[i + 1]), moving backwards from n - 2 down to 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating game trees with minimax exploring all choices takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling backward suffix dynamic programming computes optimal play in linear O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that taking prefix sums enables O(1) transitions working backwards.
